content: $G$ is a compact representation of its document. In $G$, immediate neighbors are consecutive words in the same sentence. That is, paths of length 2 correspond to bigrams. Paths of length more than 2 can correspond either to traditional $n$-grams or to relaxed $n$-grams, that is, words that never appear in the same sentence but co-occur with the same word(s). Such nodes are linked through common neighbors.
